paite: "Migilou-salou tatlekna in ka lungtang sung ah thu agen a, 'Amit ah Pathian kihtakna a-om kei,' chi in.
heading: David La / Mihing Gitlouhna
english: For the Chief Musician. By David, the servant of Yahweh. A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

paite: Athulimlouhna amukhe kei ding ua, apai tuan kei ding uh, chi in. Amah mitmuh in akiphat tawm hi.
english: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.

paite: Akam a thupawtte thulimlouhna leh khemna thu gen ahi nak a; pil leh thil hoih hih atawpta ahi.
english: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.

paite: Alupna ah thil thulim lou agel gige a; lampi hoih lou ah apai teitei a; gilou akih kei hi.
english: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.

paite: TOUPA aw, na zahngaihna vante ah a-om a; na ginomna in meipite asu hi.
heading: Pathian Hoihna
english: Your loving kindness, Yahweh, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

paite: Na diktatna Pathian tangte bang ahi; na vaihawmte tui thuk talkhauh bang ahi; TOUPA aw, mihing leh gamsa na humbit hi.
english: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. Yahweh, you preserve man and animal.

paite: "Pathian aw, na zahngaihna manpha hi na tel e! Mihing tate na kha nuai ah atu zel uhi.
english: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

paite: Amau na insung thil hoih in atai ding ua; na kipahna lui ana dawnsak ding hi.
english: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

paite: Hinna tuikhuk nang ah a-om a, na vak ah vak ka mu ding uhi.
english: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.

paite: "Aw, nangmah theite tung ah na zahngaihna kitheisak inla; lungtang diktak pute tung ah leng na diktatna langsak in.
english: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

paite: Kisathei khe hon sual ding in kei lam ah kalsuan dah henla, migilou-salou khut in hon delhmang kei hen.
english: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.

paite: "Huai ah thulimlouhna hihte apuk ua; paihkhiak in a-om ua, athou thei nawn kei ding uhi."
english: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.
